question: In a certain code language, 'FOUR' is written as 'ENTQ' and 'LIKE' is written as 'KHJD'. How will 'DOWN' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'FOUR' is written as 'ENTQ'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f33b3c260cd60b5978c5837cfd25ef44317bcb11b815943a70b81b5f331c6213.png] 

and

'LIKE' is written as 'KHJD'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fd8195854a0dbd07b3fa4338cdb501db77e10497b50ef736130fb239953a3c5.png] 

Similarly,

'DOWN' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3856ee6cebd62d9ca005c0214a49f2ab7141e74dbfa65d2c78f3948ac07b576b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"CNVM".**
